about_the_game:
Yondel is a brand-new pixel survival adventure set in an infinite, procedurally generated world. Explore vast terrains, dig deep into layered underground systems, and uncover unique environments filled with danger and discovery.

Each underground floor has its own ecosystem — with distinct mobs, ores, and powerful bosses guarding rare treasures.
Play solo or team up online with friends to explore shared worlds, conquer dungeons, and build massive bases together.

Whether you’re fighting through the depths or crafting above ground, Yondel offers endless possibilities, creativity, and survival challenges in every corner of its infinite map.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.4 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.0 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD R7 250 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
